author: Zephyr I
title: Double-step LN-ConvLSTM (64ch) + AdamW+clip — micro-sweep
abstract: Test optimizer parity with dilated-CNN SOTA: apply AdamW + global grad clipping to double-step LN-ConvLSTM(64ch) with a small hyperparameter micro-sweep around entropy and value loss coefficients.
